mil7.5.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, gorūpassa cattāri angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni cattāri angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.5.8:1.2: Yathā mahārāja gorūpo sakaṃ gehaṃ na vijahati,
mil7.5.8:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sako kāyo na vijahitabbo: anicc-ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-vikiraṇa-viddhaṃsanadhammo ayaṃ kāyo ti.
mil7.5.8:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja gorūpassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.8:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja gorūpo ādiṇṇadhuro sukhadukkhena dhuraṃ vahati,
mil7.5.8:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ādiṇṇabrahmacariyena sukhadukkhena yāva jīvitapariyādānā āpāṇakoṭikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritabbaṃ.
mil7.5.8:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja gorūpassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.8:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja gorūpo chandena ghāyamāno pānīyaṃ pivati,
mil7.5.8:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ācariyupajjhāyānaṃ anusatthi chandena pemena pasādena ghāyamānena paṭiggahetabbā.
mil7.5.8:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja gorūpassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.8:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja gorūpo yena kenaci vāhiyamāno vahati,
mil7.5.8:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena thera-nava-majjhimabhikkhūnam-pi gihiupāsakassāpi ovādānusāsanī sirasā sampaṭicchitabbā.
mil7.5.8:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja gorūpassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.8:4.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
